mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT resource_record.id) FROM iam_user_role user_role JOIN iam_role role_record ON role_record.tenant_id = user_role.tenant_id AND role_record.id = user_role.role_id JOIN iam_role_resource role_resource ON role_resource.tenant_id = user_role.tenant_id AND role_resource.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN iam_resource resource_record ON resource_record.id = role_resource.resource_id JOIN iam_tenant_subscription subscription ON subscription.tenant_id = user_role.tenant_id AND subscription.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SCHEDULED') AND subscription.effective_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND subscription.effective_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) JOIN iam_package_resource package_resource ON package_resource.package_version_id = subscription.package_version_id AND package_resource.resource_id = resource_record.id WHERE user_role.tenant_id = #{tenantId,typeHandler=com.rigour.tenant.iam.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND user_role.user_id = #{userId,typeHandler=com.rigour.tenant.iam.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND user_role.status = 'ACTIVE' AND user_role.effective_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (user_role.effective_to IS NULL OR user_role.effective_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND role_record.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role_record.deleted_at IS NULL AND role_resource.status = 'ACTIVE' AND resource_record.status = 'ACTIVE' AND resource_record.deleted_at IS NULL AND resource_record.permission_code = #{permission}

SELECT role_resource.role_id, role_resource.resource_id FROM iam_role_resource role_resource JOIN iam_role role_record ON role_record.tenant_id = role_resource.tenant_id AND role_record.id = role_resource.role_id WHERE role_resource.tenant_id = #{tenantId,typeHandler=com.rigour.tenant.iam.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND role_resource.status = 'ACTIVE' AND role_record.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT resource_record.id, resource_record.application_id, application_record.app_code AS application_code, application_record.app_name AS application_name, resource_record.parent_id, resource_record.resource_code AS code, resource_record.resource_type AS type, resource_record.permission_code, resource_record.display_name, resource_record.sort_order, resource_record.status, resource_ui.route_key, resource_ui.route_path, resource_ui.icon_key, CASE WHEN resource_record.resource_type IN ('MENU', 'PAGE') THEN COALESCE(resource_ui.visible, 0) * COALESCE(menu_config.visible, 0) ELSE 1 END AS visible, COALESCE(resource_ui.keep_alive, 0) AS keep_alive FROM iam_tenant_subscription subscription JOIN iam_package_resource package_resource ON package_resource.package_version_id = subscription.package_version_id JOIN iam_resource resource_record ON resource_record.id = package_resource.resource_id JOIN iam_application application_record ON application_record.id = resource_record.application_id LEFT JOIN iam_resource_ui resource_ui ON resource_ui.resource_id = resource_record.id LEFT JOIN iam_tenant_menu_config menu_config ON menu_config.tenant_id = subscription.tenant_id AND menu_config.resource_id = resource_record.id WHERE subscription.tenant_id = #{tenantId,typeHandler=com.rigour.tenant.iam.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND subscription.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SCHEDULED') AND subscription.effective_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND subscription.effective_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND resource_record.status = 'ACTIVE' AND resource_record.deleted_at IS NULL AND application_record.status = 'ACTIVE' AND application_record.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY application_record.sort_order, resource_record.sort_order, resource_record.resource_code
